$comment: Highest number of `unclassified` ownership entries this repository still tolerates. It ratchets DOWN, never up: when a maintainer decides what one of the reported symbols is (or the schema gains a kind for it), lower this number in the same change. Raising it hides drift, which is the exact failure P0 exists to prevent. Initialised on 2026-08-20 to the count the first generator run produced: 23 compound-component injection keys (no `injection-key` kind in schema 1.0.0), plus DzResolver, cn, themeScript, getThemeScript, warnDeprecated, resetDeprecationWarnings (no `utility` kind).
$comment.maxWithoutAnatomy: Highest number of PUBLIC COMPONENTS still allowed to ship without a declared anatomy (TASK-OSS-P3-02, ADR-19). Same ratchet, same rule: it falls when a component declares one, and raising it is how a styling contract quietly stops being one. Initialised on 2026-08-20 at 142 of 143 -- DzButton is the only component in the catalog that has declared what a consumer may address. Lowered to 138 on 2026-08-21 when TASK-OSS-P3-03 landed the five pilots -- DzButton, DzInput, DzSelect, DzDialog and DzTable (DzDialogContent also declares one, but it is a compound part and compound parts are not counted). Lowered to 137 on 2026-08-21 when TASK-OSS-P4-02 added DzProvider and DzThemeProvider: the catalog grew by one public component (DzProvider) and gained two declarations, so the number of components WITHOUT one fell by one. Both declare parts: 'none' -- renders no element of its own -- which ADR-19 counts as a declaration precisely so that 'renderless' is a promise rather than an omission. Lowered to 136 on 2026-08-24 when TASK-OSS-P5-06 added DzFileUpload: the capability-matrix gate refuses to leave a Tier D evidence row empty, and `rtl-contract` was the cell with nothing behind it. The rollout takes it to 0.
